setup.hint: Create the owner account. Log in with a 4-digit PIN; the password protects the owner area (settings, users, backup).

role.managerHint: Everything a seller can, plus returns, voids, stock, products and prices, labels, reports, discounts.
role.ownerHint: Everything — settings, users, backup/restore, audit log.

cloud.title: Cloud backup & sync
cloud.state_signedOut: sign in to the cloud again
cloud.state_notPrimary: another device is the shop tablet
cloud.pausedHelp: If the internet works: free Supabase projects are paused after 7 days without use. Sign in at supabase.com, open the project and press “Restore project”. Selling continues; everything is sent once the cloud is back.
cloud.notPrimaryHelp: Another device has been made the shop tablet, so this one stopped sending. To use this one again, disconnect and choose again.
cloud.replaceTablet: Use this device instead of a broken shop tablet
cloud.chooseTablet: The shop tablet — sends every sale to the cloud
cloud.chooseViewer: Laptop / phone — view, print labels, reports only
cloud.takeOverWarn: Another device (since {{when}}) is the shop tablet. Make this one the shop tablet instead? The other stops sending.
cloud.viewerWarn: The data on this device will be replaced by the shop tablet's copy from the cloud. Then log in with your shop PIN.
cloud.replaceWarn: Download everything from the cloud and make this the new shop tablet. Sale numbers continue. Don't use the old tablet any more.
cloud.isTablet: This is now the shop tablet — sending everything
cloud.connected: Connected — now choose what this device is
cloud.viewerBanner: View only — data from the shop tablet. Sell and make changes on the shop tablet.
cloud.step1: Create an account at supabase.com → New project (name u-ahi-pos, region Southeast Asia (Singapore))
cloud.step2: SQL Editor → New query → paste the SQL below → Run
cloud.step3: Authentication → Users → Add user → email and password (turn on Auto Confirm)
cloud.step4: Project Settings → API → copy the “Project URL” and the “anon public” key
cloud.step5: Enter them below and press Connect. Connect the laptop the same way.
